findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "postalform.pay_order" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: postalform.create_order_draft, postalform.create_letter_order_draft, postalform.create_form_order_draft, postalform.pay_order · Private data: postalform.create_pdf_upload, postalform.create_order_draft, postalform.create_letter_order_draft, postalform.create_form_order_draft, postalform.create_machine_order, postalform.pay_order, complete_checkout · Public sink: postalform.create_pdf_upload, postalform.create_letter_order_draft, postalform.pay_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: postalform.create_order_draft, postalform.create_letter_order_draft, postalform.create_form_order_draft, postalform.pay_order · Private data: postalform.create_pdf_upload, postalform.create_order_draft, postalform.create_letter_order_draft, postalform.create_form_order_draft, postalform.create_machine_order, postalform.pay_order, complete_checkout · Public sink: postalform.create_pdf_upload, postalform.create_letter_order_draft, postalform.pay_order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
